verses.translation: By the stars when they fade away
Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray
Nor does he speak of his own whims
It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺
He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power
and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form
while on the highest point above the horizon
then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close
that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less
Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺
The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw
How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw
And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time
at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—
near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—
while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours
The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach

verses.arabicText: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Laqad raā min āyāti rabbihi l-kub'rā
verses.translation: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs
Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lât and ’Uzza
and the third one, Manât, as well
Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters
Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution

verses.arabicText: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: In hiya illā asmāon sammaytumūhā antum waābāukum mā anzala l-lahu bihā min sul'ṭānin iy-yattabiʿūna illā ẓ-ẓana wamā tahwā l-anfusu walaqad jāahum mir-rabbihimu l-hudā
verses.translation: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord
Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire
In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wakam mim-malakin fī s-samāwāti lā tugh'nī shafāʿatuhum shayan illā min baʿdi ay-yadhana l-lahu limay-yashāu wayarḍā
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati layusammūna l-malāikata tasmiyata l-unthā
verses.translation: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female

verses.arabicText: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
verses.transliteration: Wamā lahum bihi min ʿil'min iy-yattabiʿūna illā ẓ-ẓana wa-inna ẓ-ẓana lā yugh'nī mina l-ḥaqi shayā
verses.translation: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth

verses.arabicText: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.transliteration: Fa-aʿriḍ ʿam-man tawallā ʿan dhik'rinā walam yurid illā l-ḥayata d-dun'yā
verses.translation: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

verses.arabicText: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Dhālika mablaghuhum mina l-ʿil'mi inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bimani ih'tadā
verses.translation: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided

verses.arabicText: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
verses.transliteration: Walillahi mā fī s-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi liyajziya alladhīna asāū bimā ʿamilū wayajziya alladhīna aḥsanū bil-ḥus'nā
verses.translation: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna yajtanibūna kabāira l-ith'mi wal-fawāḥisha illā l-lamama inna rabbaka wāsiʿu l-maghfirati huwa aʿlamu bikum idh ansha-akum mina l-arḍi wa-idh antum ajinnatun fī buṭūni ummahātikum falā tuzakkū anfusakum huwa aʿlamu bimani ittaqā
verses.translation: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth and while you were ˹still˺ fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous
Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺
and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped
Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Am lam yunabba bimā fī ṣuḥufi mūsā
verses.translation: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses
and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺
˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another

verses.arabicText: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.translation: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards
and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺
then they will be fully rewarded
and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺
Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness
And He is the One Who gives life and causes death
And He created the pairs—males and females—
from a sperm-drop when it is emitted
And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation
And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes
And He alone is the Lord of Sirius
And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd
and ˹then˺ Thamûd, sparing no one

verses.arabicText: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waqawma nūḥim-min qablu innahum kānū hum aẓlama wa-aṭghā
verses.translation: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression
And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down
How overwhelming was what covered ˹them˺
Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute
This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones
The approaching ˹Hour˺ has drawn near

verses.arabicText: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Laysa lahā min dūni l-lahi kāshifat
verses.translation: None but Allah can disclose it
Do you find this revelation astonishing
laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺
while persisting in heedlessness
Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺
